quotes.text: I’m proud to introduce this bill, a critical step towards managing the impact of AI on our cybersecurity landscape. This Task Force will enhance the safe and secure design, development, adoption, and deployment of AI across critical sectors by bringing together diverse expertise within CISA. As AI continues to evolve and integrate into our daily lives, this measure highlights our commitment to proactive risk mitigation and preparedness.

I introduced the #CISA Securing AI Task Force Act with @BennieGThompson to establish a task force within @CISAgov to address safety and security challenges posed by #AI. This is a critical step in managing the impact of AI on our #cybersecurity landscape. https://t.co/4AOI4rcJTX

At this week’s @HomelandDems hearing we discussed #AI and how to mitigate the associated risks and threats. I also discussed the importance of protecting civil rights and civil liberties within AI and my #CISA Securing AI Task Force Act. WATCH: https://t.co/Tq32acHn7F

AI is a very, very powerful tool, and can be very beneficial in so many ways, but we also know that it can be abused. [...] We cannot let this develop without there being some regulation as to the parameters for its use.

I partnered with @BennieGThompson to manage the impact of Artificial Intelligence on our cybersecurity landscape. We’re proud to introduce the #CISA Securing AI Task Force Act to establish a task force within @CISAgov that addresses safety and security challenges posed by #AI. @HomelandDems
Artificial intelligence is transforming every aspect of our economy and our society, as we well know.

But it is also going to have some downfalls and some things that are dangerous that we need to really guard against. [...] How should regulators think about contracting with innovators to integrate AI into the regulatory and oversight functions that we have, particularly in Congress?
How should lawmakers be thinking about integrating AI tools into HHS and CMS and FDA to create a more efficient process like quicker drug approvals?
And I am very, very concerned—I think we all are—about that.

The American people deserve security on all fronts —with cybersecurity being more vital than ever in an increasingly AI-impacted world. https://t.co/rjvfME5D9m

As AI technology advances, it’s our job to secure cyberspace from security threats, protect American families, and continue to foster innovation. 

Ranking Member Thompson and I are reintroducing the CISA AI Task Force Act, which will establish a task force within the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) dedicated to addressing the safety and national security challenges that come with AI technology.
